postings.title: BDR Manager
postings.description:
BDR Manager

Company Overview

Archera empowers organizations of all sizes to optimize their cloud costs through unique, short-term, insured commitments. Thousands of customers rely on Archera’s innovative FinTech solutions to increase their cloud ROI while accelerating revenue objectives and service agility.

Archera’s unique cloud rate insurance products and free FinOps platform enable teams to accurately predict and plan infrastructure growth, maximize commitment-based savings, and hedge against market demands and evolving cloud service provider offerings. Archera works closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, along with a broad partner ecosystem, to help customers execute financially prudent cloud strategies.

Position Overview

Archera is hiring a BDR Manager to lead and help scale the team that builds our sales pipeline. Reporting to the Director of Sales, you will manage a team of four BDRs of mixed seniority and own the qualified meetings (SQLs) they generate. This is a true player-coach role: you will spend real hours on the phones modeling what great outbound looks like, while coaching reps in the flow of the work, sharpening playbooks and sequences, and owning a weekly forecast with sales leadership. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to keep messaging sharp, target account lists fresh and researched, and the top of the funnel healthy.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coach a team of four BDRs of mixed seniority, running weekly one-on-ones that blend number review with real development, plus live call reviews and discovery listening; uplifting senior reps while patiently ramping more junior ones.

- Own the team’s SQL output (qualified meetings set), starting each day with a pipeline pulse on meetings booked, calendar health, show-rates, and tracking every rep against their target.

- Stay hands-on on the phones, modeling excellent outbound, jumping onto tricky prospects with more junior reps, and workshopping messaging with senior reps.

- Build and continuously refine the outbound engine: sequences, call and email playbooks, and researched, up-to-date target account lists with a clear thesis. 

- Own weekly forecasting and pipeline reporting, partnering with the Director of Sales to walk through expected SQLs and diagnose what is driving any gaps.

- Drive improvements to messaging, sequencing, and personalization, using A/B testing and leading-indicator metrics to decide what lands best with respective prospects. 

- Help hire, onboard, and ramp reps, deepening the team’s command of Archera’s domain, competitive and FinOps landscape, and buyer persona(s).

Qualifications

- 2+ years carrying and hitting a quota as a BDR/SDR

- 2+ years of successfully managing a BDR/SDR team.

- Demonstrated leadership, coaching, and mentoring range. The ability to develop reps across the seniority spectrum.

- Metrics-fluent: comfortable living in the data, forecasting off leading indicators rather than gut feel, and holding yourself and the team accountable to top-of-funnel metrics.

- Track record building and refining playbooks, sequences, and target account lists. Strategically improving process, not just running an existing one.

- Hands-on fluency with a modern sales tech stack (e.g., Apollo, Nooks, Gong, Salesforce).

- Strong command of outbound messaging and sequencing, with an eye for what makes outreach land.

- Experience selling into technical or cloud/infrastructure buyers, and familiarity with FinOps, DevOps, and/or cloud infrastructure, is a major plus.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible PTO and company holidays

- Remote-first culture

- Opportunity to shape and scale a category-defining FinTech platform

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.location: Seattle, Washington, United States, Québec, Quebec, Canada, New York, United States
postings.description:
Company Overview

Archera empowers organizations of all sizes to optimize their cloud costs through unique, short-term, insured commitments. Hundreds of customers rely on Archera's innovative FinTech solutions to increase their cloud ROI while accelerating revenue objectives and service agility.

Archera's unique cloud rate insurance products and free FinOps platform enable teams to accurately predict and plan infrastructure growth, maximize commitment-based savings, and hedge against market demands and evolving cloud service provider offerings. Archera works closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, along with a broad partner ecosystem, to help customers execute financially prudent cloud strategies.

Position Overview

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you sit where Archera's platform meets the field. This is an engineering role: you will write code, build integrations against partner and hyperscaler APIs, and own what you ship. You will also be the most technical person in the room with a distributor's engineering team, an AWS or Microsoft field counterpart, or a customer's Director of Cloud — explaining what Archera does at a deeper technical level, how other customers have successfully used Archera, and why the numbers hold. Both halves are the job.

You will report to the Senior Director of Field Engineering & GTM Enablement and work across the full deal cycle: technical discovery and commitment modeling on an enterprise pursuit one week, integration delivery or a production escalation the next. You will partner closely with Technical Account Management, Partner Development, Alliances, Marketing, Product, and Engineering. Commitment purchases and exchanges stay with Platform Operations — you set and validate the strategy. Long-term hardening and the roadmap stay with Product and Engineering — you incubate, they productize. This role is remote within the United States, with light travel.

Key Responsibilities

- Act as the technical owner on your engagements, from scoping a loosely defined problem through to something running in production.

- Build integrations and prototypes against partner and hyperscaler APIs — time-boxed MVPs, microapps, and proofs of concept that prove an idea in front of a partner or customer, then hand validated work to Product and Engineering.

- Model and defend commitment strategy against live cloud usage — reservations, savings plans, Guaranteed Commitment (GRI) economics, exchange strategy, and fleet modernization — grounded in platform data you verified yourself and presented to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.

- Take on the hardest technical problems that reach the field: complex onboarding, permissions and RBAC, billing-data integrity, and production escalations. That includes debugging live integrations directly with partner and hyperscaler engineering teams and driving fixes to closure.

- Serve as the technical overlay on large enterprise and partner pursuits, owning the technical conversation alongside Sales, Partner Development, and Alliances — including hyperscaler co-sell motions such as Azure IP Co-Sell and MACC positioning. You will influence revenue without carrying a quota.

- Close the loop with Product and Engineering: reproduce issues, isolate root cause, file and manage tickets, and distill market feedback into evidence-backed patterns and prioritized feature requests.

- Own technical documentation — analyze it for gaps, verify it against actual platform behavior, and give GTM Enablement and Marketing the source material for partner and seller training and certification.

Qualifications

- 8+ years in hands-on technical roles that include significant customer- or partner-facing work. Backgrounds that fit: forward deployed or field engineer, solutions architect, consulting engineer, technical founder, or an engineering lead at an MSP or cloud consultancy. Depth matters more than the count.

- Deep hands-on Azure experience, including its commitment and discount constructs (reservations, savings plans, exchange mechanics) and the billing mechanics underneath them: cost exports, FOCUS schema, effective cost, and custom price sheets.

- Working fluency with modern developer tooling — APIs, Git, scripting, IaC, and CI/CD — including daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code. Come ready to walk through architecture you personally built and what broke.

- Demonstrated ability to debug integration failures alongside a third party's engineering team and drive the fix to closure.

- The discipline to pressure-test your own numbers against source data before they reach a customer. A wrong savings figure in front of a CFO costs more than a slow one.

- Ability to move between audiences without losing accuracy — a technical design discussion in the morning, the same work explained to a CFO in the afternoon — plus comfort with incomplete information and the judgment to decide what is worth building and what is worth escalating.

- Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification (AZ-305) or equivalent architecture depth.

Nice-to-Haves

- Early-stage or scaling-startup experience where the role was defined by what needed doing.

- Experience in a channel or distribution motion — distributor, reseller, or CSP/MSP mechanics — and with hyperscaler marketplace and co-sell programs.

- FinOps Foundation certification (FinOps Practitioner or FOCUS Analyst) or equivalent cloud-cost discipline.

- Multi-cloud depth beyond Azure, across AWS or GCP commitment constructs.

- Published technical content: blog posts, talks, demos, or other technical evangelism.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible PTO and company holidays

- Remote-first culture

- Opportunity to shape and scale a category-defining FinTech platform

postings.description:
Company Overview

Archera empowers organizations of all sizes to optimize their cloud costs through unique, short-term, insured commitments. Hundreds of customers rely on Archera's innovative FinTech solutions to increase their cloud ROI while accelerating revenue objectives and service agility.

Archera's unique cloud rate insurance products and free FinOps platform enable teams to accurately predict and plan infrastructure growth, maximize commitment-based savings, and hedge against market demands and evolving cloud service provider offerings. Archera works closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, along with a broad partner ecosystem, to help customers execute financially prudent cloud strategies.

Position Overview

As a Partner Development Manager, you will build and grow a book of channel partners who bring Archera to their customers. Reporting to the Director of Partner Development, you will recruit new partners — distributors, resellers, MSPs, systems integrators, and cloud consultancies — turn them into active, selling partners, and work alongside AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud field teams to generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.

This is a build role. You will not inherit an existing book; you will source your own partners and your own pipeline, with a Business Development Manager supporting partner recruiting and close partnership from Archera's Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing, and Partner Operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Recruit, onboard, and activate new channel partners, and build the relationships that turn a signed agreement into a partner actively selling Archera.

- Generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and carry opportunities through to close alongside Archera's Sales team.

- Build and run joint go-to-market plans with partners and hyperscaler field teams, including co-sell motions and marketplace offers across AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud.

- Lead partner enablement: train partner sales and FinOps teams on Archera's Guaranteed Commitments and FinOps platform, and deliver the presentations and demos that make partners confident selling Archera.

- Pitch Archera to partner and customer executives up to the C-suite, and speak credibly about Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and commitment strategy.

- Keep pipeline, partner activity, and forecasts accurate in Salesforce, and report partner performance against pipeline and revenue goals.

- Represent Archera at partner, hyperscaler, and industry events, and work with Marketing on joint events, case studies, and co-marketing.

Qualifications

- 7+ years in partner development, channel sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, SaaS, or cloud services. Backgrounds that fit: partner or channel manager at a distributor, a FinOps or cloud cost optimization provider, a cloud consultancy or MSP, or a hyperscaler partner organization.

- A track record of building a channel from the ground up — recruiting partners, enabling them, and turning them into measurable sourced pipeline and revenue.

- Deep hands-on experience with at least one hyperscaler partner ecosystem (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), including partner programs, co-sell motions, and marketplace.

- Working knowledge of cloud economics and FinOps, including Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and how commitments shape a customer's cloud bill.

- Confidence presenting to and pitching C-suite executives, and the range to move between a technical conversation and a business one.

- The ability to own a partner portfolio independently: setting priorities, running partner cadences, and keeping Salesforce current.

- AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications, or a FinOps Foundation certification.

- Familiarity with AWS Partner Central and ACE, or the equivalent co-sell programs at Microsoft or Google Cloud.

- Existing relationships with resellers, distributors, or AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud field and partner teams.

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience at a distributor or with distribution and reseller mechanics, such as AWS Channel Partner Private Offers (CPPO) or Microsoft CSP.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible PTO and company holidays

- Remote-first culture

- Opportunity to shape and scale a category-defining FinTech platform

Sales Operations Engineer

Company Overview

Archera empowers organizations of all sizes to optimize their cloud costs through unique, short-term, insured commitments. Hundreds of customers rely on Archera's innovative FinTech solutions to increase their cloud ROI while accelerating revenue objectives and service agility.

Archera's unique cloud rate insurance products and free FinOps platform enable teams to accurately predict and plan infrastructure growth, maximize commitment-based savings, and hedge against market demands and evolving cloud service provider offerings. Archera works closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, along with a broad partner ecosystem, to help customers execute financially prudent cloud strategies.

Position Overview

As a Sales Operations Engineer, you own the systems and automations behind Archera's Channel Partner and AWS Alliances teams. You will build and maintain the workflows in n8n and Salesforce that carry partner referrals, opportunity routing, Alliance Manager assignment, attribution, and AWS ACE and Labra processes, and you will trace data quality issues back to the workflow that produced them instead of correcting records one at a time. You will sit with both teams on their recurring calls, hear what is slowing them down, and fix it at the source. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain n8n and Salesforce automations for partner referrals, opportunity routing, Alliance Manager assignment, attribution, AWS ACE and Labra processes, Slack notifications, and reporting.

- Work directly with the Partner and Alliances teams, joining their recurring calls to review tickets and workflows, and remove the manual work you find there.

- Keep Salesforce data accurate by reconciling records across systems, preventing duplicates, and defining which system owns each field.

- Monitor and improve the data pipeline that moves product data from the Archera application into Salesforce, working with Engineering when the root cause sits upstream.

- Design, test, and release changes safely, then monitor running workflows and troubleshoot failures before the teams feel them.

- Migrate selected Zapier workflows to n8n and build reusable components so common tasks are not rebuilt from scratch.

- Administer the GTM tool stack day to day, including integrations, governance, access, and permissions.

Qualifications

- 2+ years building and operating production automations in n8n, Zapier, or a similar platform, or in Python.

- Working knowledge of webhooks, APIs, and managing integrations across systems.

- Solid Salesforce experience, especially Flows, APIs, and the Account, Contact, and Opportunity data model, including maintaining records through automation.

- Comfort with SQL and Python for data validation, deduplication, and monitoring.

- A track record of picking up unfamiliar B2B SaaS tools quickly and putting them to work.

- Clear communication and sound judgment about what to automate, what to fix at the source, and what to escalate.

Nice-to-Haves

- Understanding of partnership revenue processes at a SaaS company, or familiarity with AWS Marketplace, ACE, Labra, partner operations, or revenue operations.

- Exposure to data engineering and pipeline tools such as Postgres/RDS, Snowflake, dbt, or Hightouch.

- FinOps or cloud cost management experience.

- Experience using Git and code review for automation or data changes.

- Experience at an early-stage or high-growth SaaS company.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible PTO and company holidays

- Remote-first culture

- Opportunity to shape and scale a category-defining FinTech platform

postings.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
postings.description:
Senior Fullstack Software Engineer

Company Overview

Archera empowers organizations of all sizes to optimize their cloud costs through unique, short-term, insured commitments. Thousands of customers rely on Archera's innovative FinTech solutions to increase their cloud ROI while accelerating revenue objectives and service agility.

Archera's unique cloud rate insurance products and free FinOps platform enable teams to accurately predict and plan infrastructure growth, maximize commitment-based savings, and hedge against market demands and evolving cloud service provider offerings. Archera works closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, along with a broad partner ecosystem, to help customers execute financially prudent cloud strategies.

Position Overview

Customers commit real money based on what Archera shows them, which makes the product surfaces you build the place where trust is either earned or lost. As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer on our Core Application team, you will build those surfaces end to end, including the interaction details on the frontend and the APIs, services, and data behind it, and keep improving them based on how customers actually use them. You will report to our Core Application engineering lead and work as a peer to product and design, shaping what gets built rather than receiving it.

Key Responsibilities

- Build customer-facing features end to end, from UI and interaction design through the supporting APIs, services, and data.

- Own and evolve our API/service layer and data models with the same depth as the frontend.

- Take features from early prototype to a polished, reliable GA experience, then keep iterating on them.

- Partner with product and design in shaping what gets built and why, turning ambiguous customer needs into clear scope.

- Ship behind feature flags, instrument what you build, and run experiments with a stated hypothesis so you know whether it worked.

- Hold the quality bar on public surfaces: performance, accessibility, and the data accuracy customers rely on to make financial decisions.

- Use AI tooling heavily to prototype, build, and review faster.

Qualifications

- 5+ years building customer-facing products, including features you took from concept to GA and owned afterward.

- Comfortable owning work on both sides of the stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend, and Python API/service on the backend. You can independently own meaningful frontend and backend work.

- Strong product sense: you translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, make sound scope calls with the context you have, and give useful critical feedback on designs.

- Startup-style range: you have owned work at both ends of the stack and moved it forward with limited direction.

- Comfortable working with real production data: understand data models and flows, investigate customer or production issues, and use data to inform product and engineering decisions.

- Fluent with AI development tools, and data-driven in how you decide what to build next.

Nice-to-Haves

- A portfolio of interfaces you are proud of, and experience working closely with designers.

- SQL, cloud data warehouses (for example Snowflake), and large product or customer datasets.

- Developer tools, cloud infrastructure, FinOps, data products, or B2B SaaS.

- Product-led growth, onboarding and activation, or growth experimentation.

- Early-stage or high-ownership product environments.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible PTO and company holidays

- Remote-first culture

- Opportunity to shape and scale a category-defining FinTech platform
